arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Hurst argued that a statutory path exists for generic drugs since 1984.
Mr. Perry argued the core issue is an administrative law challenge to the FDA.
Mr. Horwich discussed the FDA's role in writing use codes for drugs.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether a generic drug maker can sue a brand-name company over FDA use codes. Caraco seeks to dismiss the patent claim. Novo Nordisk wants the court to allow the suit to proceed.

paragraphs: This dispute determines how generic drug makers challenge brand-name patents. It affects the speed of generic drug entry into the market. It shapes the balance between patent rights and public access to medicine.
